faq.title: Answers to key questions
faq.description: All photos are from our clients after a skincare course

items.title: How much does it cost?
items.content: It really depends on what your skin actually needs. We'll pick the perfect routine for you and let you know the exact price during your consultation.

items.title: Are your products certified?
items.content: Absolutely! All of our products are officially certified for quality and safety. We'd be more than happy to show you the paperwork during our chat if you'd like.

items.title: When will I see results?
items.content: You'll probably start noticing the first changes in just a few weeks, depending on your skin. But remember, consistency is key if you want those results to last!

steps.title: MIO started with a small but very clear idea.
steps.description: At the first stage we studied skin concerns and built care systems around real customer needs. The focus was not only on packaging, but on visible results.

steps.title: The brand launched, and the first customers quickly noticed the results.
steps.description: The products were adapted for everyday use, and consultation became an important part of the service. A loyal audience started forming around MIO.

steps.title: The range expanded and the results became even more systematic.
steps.description: Separate solutions appeared for different skin needs. Customers began choosing us not only for the products, but also for the right care direction.

steps.title: Quality, service and trust came together in one place.
steps.description: We raised our quality standards and made the user journey simpler. At every step, we aimed to make the process clear and convenient.

steps.title: Today MIO makes skincare simple, aesthetic and effective.
steps.description: Our goal has not changed: helping each person find the right path for their skin. The brand is growing, but the person and their results are still at the center.
